findings.evidence: Lines 115–118 use only `finrank_pi_matrix`, the supplied algebra equivalence, and `finrank_monoidAlgebra`; lines 124–125 use only `centerCongr` and `centerPiMatrixAlgEquiv`. The existing line 127 already omits `[Finite G]` from the simp lemma, confirming that assumption is irrelevant there.
findings.fix: State the sum theorem with `[Monoid G] [Finite G]`, and state the center equivalence and simp lemma with `[Monoid G]` and no `[Finite G]`.
findings.issue: `sum_sq_eq_card_of_algEquiv_pi_matrix`, `centerMonoidAlgebraAlgEquivPi` (line 122), and its simp lemma (line 131) inherit `[Group G]`; the latter definition also inherits unused `[Finite G]`. None uses inverses, and the center construction uses no finiteness.

summary: Several presentation-dependent dimension and center results unnecessarily require a finite group although their proofs only use a monoid structure, and in two cases do not use finiteness at all.
